definitions.explanation: The Chinese dynasty that ruled from 1368 to 1644, known for its porcelain and the Great Wall in its present form. Japan's Muromachi shogunate traded with it.

examples.japanese: {明|みん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{陶磁器|とうじき}→陶磁器：15698_toujiki⟧

examples.english: The Ming dynasty was founded in 1368.

examples.japanese: {室町幕府|むろまちばくふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{明|みん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧、{勘合|かんごう}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The Muromachi shogunate traded with Ming China, using tallies called kangō to show that its ships were official.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明|みん}{代|だい}: the Ming period
- {日明|にちみん}⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧ / {勘合|かんごう}⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧: Japan–Ming trade (the tally trade)

WATCH OUT:
The reading みん belongs to the dynasty and a few historical words. Other readings include めい (⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧, ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧), みょう (⟦{明星|みょうじょう}→明星：31914_myoujou⟧) and あか (⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧).
